items.text: Before writing any deliverable, analyze EVERY file in the documents/ directory. List the directory first, then read each file in full and analyze it individually. Never write a deliverable that says analysis was 'not supplied', 'not available', 'could not be performed', or that a document was not provided — every document in the workspace IS provided. If a file is hard to parse, extract what text you can and analyze that. A deliverable that skips a document scores zero on every criterion tied to it.
